title: Exact inverse image on coefficient-sized fixed-scalar module sheaves
statement: For schemes X,Y and f:Y→X, and any commutative ring A in the independent coefficient universe, the actual functor coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback f A on module-valued sheaves of the coefficient-sized pro-etale sites [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules] preserves all colimits and finite limits, and is additive. Thus it induces the exact functor on ordinary derived categories used in [def-sfb-coefficient-fixed-derived-models]. No Noetherianity or finiteness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 00YV, proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi; Tag 00WJ, lemma-sheafification-exact; exact restriction in proof steps 2 and 3 of det-lem-integral-models-stacks.

proof.text: The existing coefficient model base-change functor preserves finite limits: it is the ordinary pro-etale base change conjugated by the AsSmall equivalences. Hence it is representably flat. Mathlib finite-limit preservation for sheafPullback gives left exactness on fixed-scalar modules.

The sheafification/Kan-extension inverse image is the left adjoint in sheafAdjunctionContinuous, so preserves colimits. A finite-product-preserving functor between these additive categories is additive.
